angle_name: Linnik collapse through the hyperbola vertex: expand R via Linnik's strict-divisor identity so the Abel sum regroups exactly into mu-weighted Piltz divisor errors at conductor 1, then attack those with Voronoi oscillatory expansions keeping the mu-sign pinned
mechanism: Stage A (exact, zero-loss regrouping): replace pi(t) by Linnik's identity pi(t) = sum_{j>=1} (-1)^{j+1} (1/j) T_j(t) + Q(t), where T_j(t) = #{n_1...n_j <= t, each n_i >= 2} is the strict j-fold divisor summatory and Q collects the exact prime-power corrections (Riemann Pi-inversion bookkeeping). Each T_j(t) = MainTerm_j(t) + Delta_j(t) with MainTerm_j a degree-(j-1) log-polynomial times t; the alternating series of main terms resums exactly to the li-side, so subtracting Li(x/d) cancels ALL smooth main terms identically, term by term in j — no triangle inequality, no Cauchy-Schwarz, an exact combinatorial cancellation. Strictness (n_i >= 2) makes the series finite: T_j(x/d) = 0 for j > log2(x/d), so at most ~log2(x) terms with benign 1/j coefficients (this is why Linnik, not Heath-Brown, whose binomial coefficients blow up at J ~ log x). The result is the exact decomposition S = sum_{j>=2} (-1)^{j+1} (1/j) E_j(x) + B(x), where E_j(x) = sum_{d<=K} mu(d) Delta_j(floor(x/d)) and B(x) is the prime-power/li-mismatch block, which involves mu-weighted smooth sums of li((x/d)^{1/k}) for k>=2 — controlled by partial summation against M(t) at scales t <= K ~ sqrt(x) ONLY (the sub-sqrt zone). Stage B (estimation, where new bounds are needed): each Delta_j admits a Voronoi-type oscillatory expansion at conductor 1 — for j=2, Delta_2(t) ~ t^{1/4} sum_n tau(n) n^{-3/4} cos(4 pi sqrt(nt) - pi/4) — so E_j becomes exponential sums sum_{d<=K} mu(d) (x/d)^{(j-1)/(2j)} e_j(n, x/d) in which the Mobius sign is still attached to its own variable and can be played against the analytic phase via Perron/zero-density in d, rather than being destroyed by a modulus-square split. The d-variable is never recombined by Cauchy-Schwarz/Hoelder/triangle at any point before the final scalar exponential-sum bounds; mu(d) is consumed only against explicit oscillation. The truncation d <= K sits exactly at the hyperbola vertex (x/d >= y ~ sqrt(x)), so every Delta_j argument is >= sqrt(x) and every M argument in B is <= sqrt(x): the identity cleanly separates a super-sqrt divisor-error zone (attack with Voronoi) from a sub-sqrt Mertens zone (the only place any inductive/self-consistent input is invoked). Parity is not broken: the RH-hardness is redistributed into E_j for j of size ~log x / loglog x, where known Delta_j bounds (t^{1-c/j}) go trivial — I claim honest unconditional wins on low j and an exact, kernel-formalizable skeleton, not a parity miracle.
new_leverage: UNVERIFIED SPECULATION, per protocol. Three claimed levers, none of which appear in the F-closure class: (1) the recombination over d is an exact identity (Linnik main-term/li resummation), so the mu x R sign interaction is carried intact into mu x Delta_j interactions — the exponent-expanding split F(sigma) >= 1/2 + sigma/2 is never triggered because no M^2-moment input and no d-splitting inequality is used; (2) Delta_j lives at conductor 1, so Voronoi summation is available without any pair-to-modulus transfer, sidestepping the fiber-growth counterexample entirely — the only 'frequencies' are Voronoi indices n <= x^eps after truncation; (3) strict Linnik coefficients 1/j with hard cutoff j <= log2(x/d) give a finite series with summable weights, unlike Heath-Brown's C(J,j) blowup, so the decomposition itself costs only a log factor. Secondary lever: the vertex truncation K = floor(x/(y+1)) makes the mismatch block B a pure sub-sqrt(x) Mertens object, aligning exactly with the chain's declared self-consistency of the boundary term at 1/2 — if the kernel chain supports any scale-induction hook, B is the legitimately inductive piece.
target_estimate: Named estimate 'E_j vertex bounds': for K = floor(x/(y+1)), y ~ sqrt(x), and Delta_j the strict j-fold Piltz divisor error, bound E_j(x) = sum_{d <= K} mu(d) Delta_j(floor(x/d)) for 2 <= j <= ceil(log2 x), needing sum_j (1/j)|E_j| << x^{1/2+eps}, together with the mismatch block B(x) (prime-power li terms) << x^{1/2+eps} using M(t) only at t <= K. Losses and honest accounting: (i) B via partial summation costs int_1^K |M(t)| x^{1/2} t^{-3/2} dt — with unconditional M(t) << t exp(-c sqrt(log t)) this is x^{3/4} exp(-c' sqrt(log x)), i.e. the mechanism stalls just below x^{3/4} unless the sub-sqrt zone is inductively admissible at t^{1/2+eps} (then B << x^{1/2+eps}); (ii) triangle on pointwise Delta_2(t) << t^{131/416} gives E_2 << x^{1/3} K^{2/3} ~ x^{2/3+eps} free; the mu-vs-phase version targets E_2 << x^{7/12+eps} via sum_{d<=K} mu(d)(x/d)^{1/4} cos(4 pi sqrt(n x/d)); (iii) large j: known Delta_j << t^{1-c/j} gives E_j << x^{1-c/(2j)}, trivial for j >~ log x — this is where rung 2 dies without new input; the honest unconditional yield of the full mechanism is therefore the decomposition identity plus power-saving bounds on each fixed-j component, not x^{1/2+eps} on S.

obstacle_positions.F_closure: Exited by construction: only Mertens input is pointwise M at t <= K in block B (not M^2 moments), and recombination over d is exact Linnik/li resummation — no Cauchy-Schwarz, Hoelder, or triangle step over d occurs before the final scalar exponential sums; mu's sign survives into E_j and is spent against Voronoi phases.
obstacle_positions.fiber_growth: Bypassed, not solved: no pair-to-modulus transfer is attempted; all objects stay in divisor-lattice coordinates at conductor 1 (divisor Voronoi), so the linear-fiber counterexample's coordinates never arise.
obstacle_positions.pinned_vs_averaged: The decomposition is exact at the pinned x, and Voronoi expansions of Delta_j are pointwise-valid at every argument; no L2-averaged translation estimate is used in the skeleton. Risk re-enters only if the final exponential sums in d are estimated by mean-value theorems — flagged as the point where the pinned-point discipline could silently break; the plan is Perron/zero-density in the d-variable, which is pointwise in x.
obstacle_positions.modulus_magnitude: Irrelevant to this mechanism: no wheel or primorial modulus appears; the largest arithmetic conductor is the truncation length of the Voronoi frequency n, polynomial in x, and sqrt(full-modulus) heuristics are never invoked.
obstacle_positions.parity: Not broken, and I say so plainly: mu enters linearly, one mu is consumed per collapse step, and the parity wall reappears exactly as the large-j terms E_j (j >~ log x/loglog x) where Delta_j bounds are trivial. The mechanism's honest role is to localize parity hardness there while extracting unconditional power savings from the low-j, parity-safe components.
obstacle_positions.circularity: Clean on the R side: no pointwise bound on R(t) is used at any argument >= y; the d=1 term R(x) is expanded into divisor errors like every other term. The one conditional-flavored input is M(t) << t^{1/2+eps} for t <= K ~ sqrt(x) inside block B, invoked ONLY if the kernel chain's self-consistency structure makes the sub-sqrt zone legitimately inductive; otherwise B falls back to unconditional M and the mechanism stalls at x^{3/4-o(1)}. This is declared, not hidden.
obstacle_positions.finite_range: Numerics are used exclusively to falsify: the kill test checks the exact identity to error zero and measures whether the predicted cancellations exist in-range; the flat 0.35-0.43 calibration is treated as consistent-with-target only, and no exponent is inferred from range <= 10^9, per the Mertens-conjecture lesson.

kill_test: One afternoon of exact integer computation at x in {10^7, 10^8, 10^9}: (1) compute S, all E_j, and B exactly (sieve tau_j-strict up to x, Mertens up to K, primes to x) and verify the decomposition identity S = sum_j (-1)^{j+1} E_j / j + B to exactly 0 — any nonzero residual kills the bookkeeping (prime-power/li matching) and the angle; (2) measure r_2(K) = |E_2| / sum_{d<=K} |Delta_2(floor(x/d))| across 5 decades of K: if r_2 shows no decay on the order of K^{-1/2 +- eps}, the claimed mu-vs-Voronoi-phase cancellation (lever 2) is empirically dead; (3) measure the mass of the block sum_{j>10} |E_j|/j: if it carries the dominant share at scale >= x^{3/4} in-range, the redistribution claim fails and rung-1-via-this-route dies. All three are cheap, exact, and each independently kills a load-bearing claim.
rung0_plan: Prove (paper-level, and Lean-formalizable at bounded effort since it is finite exact combinatorics in the style of the existing PrimeSieveAbelIdentity.lean) the exact decomposition identity S = sum_{j=2}^{ceil(log2 x)} (-1)^{j+1} (1/j) E_j(x) + B(x) with B written explicitly, then feed unconditional pointwise inputs through it — Vinogradov-Korobov for the low-j Delta bounds and classical M(t) << t exp(-c sqrt(log t)) for B — to obtain S << x exp(-c (log x)^{3/5-eps}), an o(trivial-scale) PNT-strength bound produced BY the mechanism end-to-end rather than by naive triangle+PNT, demonstrating the pipeline runs. Deliverables: the identity lemma (kernel candidate) plus the unconditional bound.
plausible_partial: Named partial 'E_2 Voronoi bound', bounded effort, unconditional: E_2(x) = sum_{d<=K} mu(d) Delta_2(floor(x/d)) << x^{2/3+eps} immediately from pointwise Delta_2(t) << t^{1/3} (triangle over d — permissible here because the object is Delta_2, outside the F-closure class), with a realistic strengthening to E_2 << x^{7/12+eps} by inserting the truncated Voronoi expansion and extracting Mobius cancellation from sum_{d<=K} mu(d) (x/d)^{1/4} e(2 sqrt(n x / d)) via Perron against 1/zeta. Both land strictly below the x^{3/4} empirical triangle scale for that component and are publishable standalone lemmas; combined with the rung-0 identity they constitute the mechanism's defensible near-term yield.
self_assessed_risk: All capability claims UNVERIFIED speculation, as required. Risk that rung 2 is unreachable by this angle alone: HIGH and expected — parity re-concentrates in the large-j tail (E_j trivial for j >~ log x), so x^{1/2+eps} on S would need genuinely new input there; I am not claiming otherwise. Risk to the rung-0 identity and the E_2 << x^{2/3+eps} partial: LOW-MEDIUM (exact combinatorics plus standard Voronoi; the delicate part is the prime-power/li-mismatch bookkeeping in B, which the kill test checks to error zero). Weakest assumption, stated plainly: that block B — mu-weighted smooth li((x/d)^{1/k}) terms controlled by M at scales <= sqrt(x) — is admissible at strength t^{1/2+eps} through the kernel chain's self-consistency/induction structure; if the chain offers no such hook, the full mechanism stalls at x^{3/4-o(1)} regardless of how well every E_j is bounded. Secondary risk: the claimed mu-vs-phase cancellation in E_2 beyond triangle (x^{7/12} target) may fail at the pinned x, which the kill test's r_2(K) measurement probes directly before any proof effort is spent.
